name: Choir & Music
tagline: Ministering in songs and leading the congregation into worship.
description: The Choir & Music department leads ACONSU in praise and worship during services, rehearses new songs, and ministers at outreaches and special programs. Open to anyone who can sing or play an instrument.

name: Ushering
tagline: Serving with excellence at the doors of the house of God.
description: Ushers welcome members and guests, manage seating and order during services, and help every first-timer feel at home.

name: Media & Technical
tagline: Sound, visuals and livestream — the unseen hands behind every service.
description: This unit handles sound engineering, projection, livestreaming and photography/videography for services, events and social media.

name: Protocol
tagline: Coordinating order and hospitality for guests and ministers.
description: Protocol handles the reception and coordination of guest ministers, dignitaries and special guests, and helps keep events running smoothly.

name: Welfare
tagline: Caring for the practical needs of every student in the union.
description: Welfare looks out for the wellbeing of members — visiting the sick, supporting students in need, and organizing care initiatives on campus.

name: Prayer Band
tagline: Standing in the gap through intercession.
description: The Prayer Band leads intercessory prayer sessions, prays over member requests, and covers ACONSU's programs in prayer.

name: Evangelism & Drama
tagline: Taking the gospel to campus through outreach and the arts.
description: This unit organizes campus outreaches, hostel-to-hostel evangelism, and uses drama and creative arts to communicate the gospel.

name: Publicity & Social Media
tagline: Telling ACONSU's story online and across campus.
description: Publicity manages ACONSU's social media pages, designs flyers and announcements, and publicizes upcoming events on and off campus.
